feature_spec.target: log_amount_usd (invert predictions with exp to obtain USD)

derived_features.destination_region: Mapped from normalized destination city using the notebook city-location map.
derived_features.international: 1 when normalized origin and destination countries differ, else 0.
derived_features.advance_days: Corrected travel date minus booking date, in days; negative values become missing.
derived_features.trip_length_days: Corrected return date minus corrected travel date, in days; negative values become missing.
derived_features.peak_season: 1 for travel months June, July, August, or December; otherwise 0.

feature_spec.selection_metric: Lowest held-out MAE ($231.850); RMSE $1,012.344, R2 0.506, WAPE 0.184.
